function.name: get_industrial_signal
function.description: Get the full investment signal for an industrial ticker. Returns conviction score, archetype (constrained/oscillatory/fragile/resilient/saturated/decoupled), trajectory (improving/stable/deteriorating), ECL and PFSL adjustments, regime multiplier, supply chain risk, options structure recommendation, and signal notes. Use this before any investment discussion about an industrial company.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. HON, CAT, GE, ROK, EMR. Will be uppercased automatically.

industry.description: Optional industry hint to improve ECL weighting. Examples: hvac, auto, aerospace_defense, utilities, energy_midstream, financials, tech, reit. Omit for default industrial engine.

function.name: screen_industrial_signals
function.description: Screen all tracked industrial tickers by conviction score, signal type, or archetype. Returns a ranked list of top signals — use this to find the best-positioned industrials or identify high-conviction opportunities across the universe.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 20, max 100.

min_conviction.description: Minimum conviction threshold. Range -1.0 to +1.0. Default 0.25. Use 0.50 for BUY-only, 0.72 for STRONG_BUY only.

signal.description: Filter by signal type: STRONG_BUY, BUY, WATCH, NEUTRAL, SELL, STRONG_SELL, EARLY_WARNING. Omit to return all.

archetype.description: Filter by archetype: constrained, oscillatory, fragile, resilient, saturated, decoupled. Omit to return all.

function.name: get_macro_regime
function.description: Get the current External Constraint Layer (ECL) macro regime and all 7 module scores: CPI (commodity cost pressure), EPI (energy), LPI (labor), DCSI (demand/channel stress), DLPS (decision latency), ROC (regime multiplier applied to all conviction scores), and DCS (data confidence). Use this to understand macro tailwinds and headwinds before interpreting individual signals.

industry.description: Optional industry for sector-specific ECL weights. Examples: hvac, auto, utilities, energy_midstream, financials, tech, reit, plate_steel, infrastructure. Omit for general industrial regime.

function.name: get_diligence_report
function.description: Get a full industrial operational diligence brief for a company. Returns a 6-section structured analysis: (1) operational genome fingerprint, (2) leadership and org signals, (3) supply chain risk, (4) pre-financial signal layer from SEC EDGAR, (5) comparable companies by archetype similarity, (6) priority diligence questions for deal teams. Use for M&A diligence, PE platform assessments, or deep-dive company research.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. HON, CAT, ROK, EMR, GE.

format.description: Response format. 'full' returns complete JSON report (default). 'json_compact' returns only conviction, risk flags, diligence questions, and comparable tickers — more token-efficient for agent use.
